# Pembagian Training dan Testing Data
```{r}
ts_sunspot<-ts_tahunan
n_total <- length(ts_sunspot)
n_test <- 0.2*n_total
n_train <- n_total - n_test

train_data <- window(ts_sunspot, end = time(ts_sunspot)[n_train])
test_data <- window(ts_sunspot, start = time(ts_sunspot)[n_train + 1])
train_data
test_data
```
```{r}
plot(train_data, 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Rata-rata Sunspot", 
     main = "Data Training")
```
```{r}
plot(test_data, 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlab = "Tahun", ylab = "Rata-rata Sunspot", 
     main = "Data Testing")
```

```{r}
min(train_data)
```


# Uji Stasioneritas
## Uji Fligner-Killeen
```{r}

                    breaks = c(1969, 1990, 2005, 2026), 
                    labels = c("1970-1990", "1991-2005", "2006-2026"))

fligner.test(Sunspot ~ Periode, data = data)
```


```{r}

  Tahun = as.numeric(time(train_log)),
  Sunspot_Log = as.numeric(train_log)
)
```

# Non-Seasonal
## ACF
```{r}
acf(train_log, lag.max = 55)
```

## PACF
```{r}
pacf(train_log, lag.max = 55)
```
Tanpa differencing karena stasioner dalam rataan (d=0). PACF cut off, indikasi AR(2) (p=2). ACF tails off, indikasi MA(0) (q=0). 
# Seasonal 
## Lag 11
### Differencing
```{r}
D1 <- diff(train_log, lag = 11) 
plot.ts(D1, lty=1, xlab="Waktu", ylab="Data Difference Seasonal 1 Sunspot", main="Plot Difference Seasonal")
```
Indikasi D=1, s=11.
### ACF setelah differencing musiman
```{r}
acf(D1, lag.max = 55, main = "ACF Setelah Differencing Musiman 11")
```
Indikasi Seasonal MA (Q=0). Indikasi q=1 atau q=0.
### PACF setelah differencing
```{r}
pacf(D1, lag.max = 55, main = "PACF Setelah Differencing Musiman 11")
```
Indikasi Seasonal AR (P=0). Indikasi p=2.

# Model Holt Winter

```{r}
train_ts_11 <- ts(train_data, frequency = 11)

winter <- HoltWinters(train_ts_11, alpha = 0.2, beta = 0.1, gamma = 0.3, seasonal = "multiplicative")

winter.opt <- HoltWinters(train_ts_11, alpha = NULL, beta = NULL, gamma = NULL, seasonal = "multiplicative")
```

```{r}
n_ramal <- length(test_data)
forecast_manual <- predict(winter, n.ahead = n_ramal)
forecast_opt <- predict(winter.opt, n.ahead = n_ramal)
```

```{r}
aktual_all <- as.numeric(c(train_data, test_data)) 

pred_manual <- as.numeric(forecast_manual)
pred_opt    <- as.numeric(forecast_opt)

start_forecast <- length(train_data) + 1
end_forecast   <- length(aktual_all)
batas_y <- max(aktual_all, pred_manual, pred_opt, na.rm = TRUE) + 20
plot(1:length(aktual_all), aktual_all, 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Waktu (Tahun)", ylab = "Jumlah Sunspot",
     main = "Perbandingan Holt-Winters (Manual vs Optimasi)",
     ylim = c(0, batas_y), xlim = c(1, length(aktual_all)))

abline(v = length(train_data), col = "gray50", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
lines(start_forecast:end_forecast, pred_manual, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
lines(start_forecast:end_forecast, pred_opt, col = "blue", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
legend("topleft", 
       legend = c("Aktual", "Winter Manual", "Winter Optimasi", "Batas Train/Test"),
       col = c("black", "red", "blue", "gray50"), 
       lty = c(1, 2, 2, 2), lwd = 2, bty = "n")
```

```{r}
alpha_mul <- winter.opt$alpha
beta_mul  <- winter.opt$beta
gamma_mul <- winter.opt$gamma

ada_tren_mul <- ifelse(beta_mul > 0.01, TRUE, FALSE)
ada_musiman_mul <- ifelse(gamma_mul > 0.01, TRUE, FALSE)

cat("Parameter Optimasi (Alpha, Beta, Gamma):\n")
print(c(alpha_mul, beta_mul, gamma_mul))
cat("Ada Tren?", ada_tren_mul, "| Ada Musiman?", ada_musiman_mul, "\n\n")
```



## Akurasi Data Latih
```{r}
fitted_manual      <- as.numeric(winter$fitted[, 1])          
aktual_train_clean <- as.numeric(train_data)
selisih            <- length(aktual_train_clean) - length(fitted_manual)
aktual_train_clean <- aktual_train_clean[(selisih + 1):length(aktual_train_clean)]

error_train <- aktual_train_clean - fitted_manual
n_train_eff <- length(aktual_train_clean)  

sse_train  <- sum(error_train^2)
mse_train  <- sse_train / n_train_eff
rmse_train <- sqrt(mse_train)
mape_train <- mean(abs(error_train / aktual_train_clean) * 100)

fitted_opt       <- as.numeric(winter.opt$fitted[, 1])
aktual_opt_clean <- as.numeric(train_data)
selisih          <- length(aktual_opt_clean) - length(fitted_opt)
aktual_opt_clean <- aktual_opt_clean[(selisih + 1):length(aktual_opt_clean)]

error_opt  <- aktual_opt_clean - fitted_opt
n_opt_eff  <- length(aktual_opt_clean)

sse_opt  <- sum(error_opt^2)
mse_opt  <- sse_opt / n_opt_eff
rmse_opt <- sqrt(mse_opt)
mape_opt <- mean(abs(error_opt / aktual_opt_clean) * 100)

mape_opt
```
## Akurasi Data Uji
```{r}
aktual_test <- as.numeric(test_data)
pred_test_manual <- as.numeric(forecast_manual)
pred_test_opt <- as.numeric(forecast_opt)

hitung_error <- function(prediksi, aktual) {
  error <- aktual - prediksi
  sse <- sum(error^2)
  mse <- sse / length(aktual)
  rmse <- sqrt(mse)
  mape <- mean(abs((error / aktual) * 100), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  naive_err <- diff(as.numeric(train_data), lag = 11)
  mase <- mean(abs(error)) / mean(abs(naive_err))
  
  return(c(SSE = sse, MSE = mse, RMSE = rmse, MAPE = mape, MASE = mase))
}
```
```{r}
hasil_manual <- hitung_error(pred_test_manual, aktual_test)
hasil_opt <- hitung_error(pred_test_opt, aktual_test)

akurasi_testing <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Winter Manual", "Winter Optimum"),
  SSE   = c(hasil_manual["SSE"], hasil_opt["SSE"]),
  RMSE  = c(hasil_manual["RMSE"], hasil_opt["RMSE"]),
  MAPE  = c(hasil_manual["MAPE"], hasil_opt["MAPE"]),
  MASE  = c(hasil_manual["MASE"], hasil_opt["MASE"])
)

print(akurasi_testing)
```
# Perbandingan SARIMA dan Holt Winter
## Testing
```{r}
aktual <- as.numeric(test_data)

pred_sarima <- as.numeric(exp(predict(model6, n.ahead = length(aktual))$pred))
pred_holt <- as.numeric(forecast_opt)

hitung_metrik <- function(prediksi, aktual, nama_model, train_data) {
  error <- aktual - prediksi
  rmse <- sqrt(mean(error^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  mae  <- mean(abs(error), na.rm = TRUE)
  mape <- mean(abs((error / aktual) * 100), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  naive_err <- diff(as.numeric(train_data), lag = 11)
  mase <- mae / mean(abs(naive_err), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  return(data.frame(
    Model = nama_model,
    RMSE = round(rmse, 2),
    MAE = round(mae, 2),
    MAPE = round(mape, 2),
    MASE = round(mase, 4)
  ))
}

hasil_sarima <- hitung_metrik(pred_sarima, aktual, "SARIMA (Model 6)", train_data)
hasil_holt   <- hitung_metrik(pred_holt, aktual, "Holt-Winters Opt", train_data)

tabel_perbandingan <- rbind(hasil_sarima, hasil_holt)
print(tabel_perbandingan)
```
## Training
```{r}
fitted_sarima_log <- as.numeric(fitted(model6))
fitted_sarima     <- exp(fitted_sarima_log)          
aktual_train_full <- as.numeric(train_data)

valid_idx            <- which(!is.na(fitted_sarima))
aktual_sarima_train  <- aktual_train_full[valid_idx]
fitted_sarima_train  <- fitted_sarima[valid_idx]

fitted_holt_train <- as.numeric(winter.opt$fitted[, 1])
aktual_holt_train <- as.numeric(train_data)

if (length(fitted_holt_train) < length(aktual_holt_train)) {
  selisih          <- length(aktual_holt_train) - length(fitted_holt_train)
  aktual_holt_train <- aktual_holt_train[(selisih + 1):length(aktual_holt_train)]
}

hitung_metrik_train <- function(prediksi, aktual, nama_model, train_data) {
  error <- aktual - prediksi
  rmse  <- sqrt(mean(error^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  mae   <- mean(abs(error), na.rm = TRUE)
  mape  <- mean(abs((error / aktual) * 100), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  naive_err <- diff(as.numeric(train_data), lag = 11)
  mase <- mae / mean(abs(naive_err), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  data.frame(
    Model = nama_model,
    RMSE  = round(rmse, 2),
    MAE   = round(mae, 2),
    MAPE  = round(mape, 2),
    MASE  = round(mase, 4)
  )
}

hasil_train_sarima <- hitung_metrik_train(fitted_sarima_train,
                                          aktual_sarima_train,
                                          "SARIMA (Model 6)", train_data)
hasil_train_holt   <- hitung_metrik_train(fitted_holt_train,
                                          aktual_holt_train,
                                          "Holt-Winters Opt", train_data)

tabel_train <- rbind(hasil_train_sarima, hasil_train_holt)
print(tabel_train)
```
```{r}
model6_orig <- Arima(train_data,
                     order        = c(1, 0, 1),
                     seasonal     = list(order = c(0, 1, 1), period = 11))

sarima_AIC  <- as.numeric(model6_orig$aic)
sarima_AICc <- as.numeric(model6_orig$aicc)
sarima_BIC  <- as.numeric(model6_orig$bic)

resid_hw <- as.numeric(residuals(winter.opt))
resid_hw <- resid_hw[is.finite(resid_hw)]        
n_hw     <- length(resid_hw)
SSE_hw   <- sum(resid_hw^2)
sigma2   <- SSE_hw / n_hw

LL_hw <- -n_hw/2 * (log(2 * pi * sigma2) + 1)
k_hw <- 3 + 2 + (11 - 1)                          

AIC_hw  <- -2 * LL_hw + 2 * k_hw
AICc_hw <- AIC_hw + 2 * k_hw * (k_hw + 1) / (n_hw - k_hw - 1)
BIC_hw  <- -2 * LL_hw + k_hw * log(n_hw)

tabel_ic <- data.frame(
  Model = c("SARIMA (1,0,1)(0,1,1)[11]",
            "Holt-Winters Optimum"),
  n     = c(attr(logLik(model6_orig), "nobs"), n_hw),
  k     = c(attr(logLik(model6_orig), "df"),   k_hw),
  AIC   = round(c(sarima_AIC,  AIC_hw),  2),
  AICc  = round(c(sarima_AICc, AICc_hw), 2),
  BIC   = round(c(sarima_BIC,  BIC_hw),  2)
)
print(tabel_ic)
```
